== Summary ==
Interim text, 31 December 2003: Boba Fett (V), as printed in the Players Committee's rules supplement “Star Wars CCG Changes to Virtual Set #6” (Section 2. Updated Dark Side Texts) for [[Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds]]. The supplement prints text only (no slip).

Source: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040615005231/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Resources/v6changes.pdf v6changes.pdf] (swccgpc.com, “Updated 31 Dec 2003”, PDF dated 31 December 2003; Internet Archive capture 15 June 2004), page 1, the card's entry (title and text). The PDF page was rendered at 200 dpi and the card's entry cut out; nothing else was changed.

Used on: [[Boba Fett (V) (Virtual Set 6: City In The Clouds) (Original)|Boba Fett (V) (Virtual Set 6)]].
